title: Unit 11: Animal World: Past Simple Regular Verbs
objective: Mampu menggunakan Past Simple untuk menceritakan kejadian di masa lampau menggunakan kata kerja beraturan (regular verbs), serta mampu bertanya dan menjawab tentang aktivitas masa lalu.

theory.summary: Past Simple adalah bentuk kata kerja yang digunakan untuk menceritakan kejadian yang sudah selesai di masa lampau. Untuk regular verbs (kata kerja beraturan), kita menambahkan -ed pada akhir kata kerja dasar.
rules: Positive: Subject + verb + -ed (I helped my friend yesterday / She worked in a factory)
Negative: Subject + didn't + base verb (I didn't help / She didn't work)
Question: Did + subject + base verb? (Did you help? / Did she work?)
Was/Were untuk be: I/He/She/It was, You/We/They were (I was at home / They were happy)

Aturan penambahan -ed: Jika kata kerja berakhiran -e, tambahkan -d saja (move → moved). Jika berakhiran konsonan + y, ubah y menjadi i lalu tambahkan -ed (try → tried). Jika berakhiran konsonan pendek setelah vokal pendek, gandakan konsonan terakhir (stop → stopped)

commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering lupa menghilangkan -ed saat menggunakan didn't atau did, karena bentuk negatif dan tanya sudah menggunakan auxiliary verb 'did'.
commonTrap.wrong: I didn't helped my friend / Did you worked yesterday?
commonTrap.correct: I didn't help my friend / Did you work yesterday?

dialogue.context: Jenny kehilangan ponselnya dan menelepon Pedro untuk bertanya apakah ponselnya ada di rumah Pedro atau di toko sepatu.

lines.speaker: Jenny
lines.text: My phone? Where is it? It was in my jacket!
lines.translation: Ponselku? Di mana? Tadi ada di jaketku!

lines.speaker: Pedro
lines.text: OK, calm down. Where were you this morning?
lines.translation: OK, tenang. Kamu di mana tadi pagi?

lines.speaker: Jenny
lines.text: Well, I was at home from nine o'clock to ten o'clock.
lines.translation: Yah, aku di rumah dari jam sembilan sampai jam sepuluh.

lines.speaker: Pedro
lines.text: And then? Were you in town?

lines.speaker: Jenny
lines.text: Yes, I was at the shopping centre. And I'm 100% sure that my phone was in my pocket.
lines.translation: Ya, aku di pusat perbelanjaan. Dan aku 100% yakin ponselku ada di sakuku.

lines.speaker: Pedro
lines.text: And then? Was Steve or Maisie with you?
lines.translation: Lalu? Apakah Steve atau Maisie bersamamu?

lines.speaker: Jenny
lines.text: No, they weren't. I was in the shoe shop. I bought some new shoes.
lines.translation: Tidak. Aku di toko sepatu. Aku membeli sepatu baru.

lines.speaker: Pedro
lines.text: Wait a minute. Let me call you.
lines.translation: Tunggu sebentar. Biar aku telepon kamu.

lines.speaker: Jenny
lines.text: It's ringing! Oh, look! It's in the shoe bag! It was there all the time!
lines.translation: Berdering! Oh, lihat! Ada di kantong sepatu! Ternyata ada di sana!

speakingLab.context: Latihan percakapan tentang aktivitas masa lalu dengan Mr. Khoirul. Siswa akan menceritakan kegiatan kemarin menggunakan Past Simple.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! How are you today? Let's talk about yesterday. Where were you yesterday morning?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I was at home yesterday morning.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's nice. What did you do at home? Did you watch TV or help your family?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I helped my mother in the kitchen and I watched TV after that.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Great! And what about the afternoon? Were you at home or did you go somewhere?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I visited my friend's house in the afternoon. We played games together.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Wonderful! It sounds like you had a nice day. What time did you arrive back home?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I arrived home at six o'clock in the evening.

quiz.question: Valentina Tereshkova ___ born in Russia on 6th March, 1937.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'was' karena subjeknya singular (Valentina) dan kalimatnya tentang masa lampau.

quiz.question: The training programme ___ very easy, but Tereshkova was hard working.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'wasn't' (was not) karena subjeknya singular (the training programme) dan ini adalah bentuk negatif dari 'was'.

quiz.question: Storm's story ___ in New York.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'started' karena ini adalah Past Simple (cerita dimulai di masa lampau). Regular verb 'start' + -ed.

quiz.question: Percy and Tyson ___ to help each other.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'tried' karena Past Simple. Kata 'try' berakhiran konsonan + y, maka y diubah menjadi i lalu ditambah -ed.

quiz.question: Did you ___ at the shopping centre yesterday?
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'Did' gunakan base form (bentuk dasar). Base form dari was/were adalah 'be'.

quiz.question: My friends and I ___ at the cinema last night.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'were' karena subjeknya plural (my friends and I) dan kalimatnya tentang masa lampau (last night).
